page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Markdown rule sets your review agents follow. Click a skill to preview it.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create your first skill: a Markdown rule set an agent applies when it reviews a PR.

noMatch.title: No matching skills
noMatch.body: No skill name or description matches “{query}”.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

card.agents: {count, plural, =0 {no agents} one {# agent} other {# agents}}

delete.title: Delete skill?
delete.body: Delete “{name}” and its whole version history?
delete.usage: {count, plural, =0 {No agent uses it.} one {It will be removed from # agent. The agent itself is kept.} other {It will be removed from # agents. The agents themselves are kept.}}

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a Markdown rule set. The body is the only text sent to the model.
create.name: Name
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What this skill makes the agent check
create.bodyPlaceholder:
# Rule
Describe what the reviewer must flag, with a good / bad example.

errors.name: Enter a name (up to 120 characters).
errors.body: Enter the skill body in Markdown.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.bodyHint: The only text sent to the model. Saving a changed body snapshots it as v{next}; other fields are metadata and keep v{current}.
config.bodyStats: {lines, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} · ~{tokens} tokens
config.dangerBody: Removes it from every agent that uses it and deletes its version history. This can’t be undone.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versioning.title: Version history
versioning.subtitle: Every saved body is an immutable snapshot. Restoring an old one creates a new version; nothing is overwritten.
versioning.alreadyCurrent: v{from} already matches the current body — nothing to restore.
versioning.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versioning.empty: No versions recorded for this skill.

diff.title: v{from} → v{to} (current)
diff.identical: No differences — this version has the same body as the current one.
diff.label: Changes from v{from} to the current version

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
